al_compendium_name: Aesir Lineage - Star Maps and Oaths
al_compendium_no_points: No deity has granted you star points yet. Offer tributes at their shrines.
al_sacrifice_header_desc: Ask the deity of this shrine for a blessing.
al_prestige_header_desc: Reborn again, you will gain prestige and increase your challenge. Shed mortal knowledge, increase your rewards.
al_gefjun_description: The goddess of agriculture, known as the generous one. With her guidance your harvests may be bountiful.
al_baldur_description: The god of light and purity, known for his invulnerability. With his blessing light the darkest paths.
al_freya_description: The goddess of love and war, a fierce and passionate deity. With her favor, may your battles be victorious.
al_hel_description: The goddess of the underworld, balancer of life and death. With her power, may you find strength in the face of death.
al_skaldi_description: The goddess of the hunt and winter. With her guidance, may your arrows strike true and storm be at your back.
al_vor_description: The goddess of wisdom and curiosity. With her insight, may you see the path ahead clearly and avoid unseen dangers.
al_syn_description: The goddess of defense and protection. Stand tall in the face of any foe.
al_vidarr_description: The silent god, Odin's son, who will avenge his father on the wolf at the world's end and live on in the world after. With his strength, may you outlast the long winter.
al_shrine_intro: $1 watches over these lands. Do what $1 asks of you to earn a blessing for your travels here.
al_use_no_effect: This deity does not seem interested in this.
al_shrine_lucky: Lucky deeds $1 has rewarded this run: $2 of $3.
al_deed_miniboss: $1 honours your victory over $2: +$3 star points
al_deed_herald: $1 honours your victory over $2, herald of Ragnarök: +$3 star points
al_quest_wait: $1 has another quest for you in $2 days.
al_quest_tomorrow: $1 has another quest for you tomorrow.
al_blessing_desc: $1 lends you this once a day.
al_blessing_locked: Complete $1's quest this run to earn this blessing.
al_shrine_reset_confirm: Press Reset Stars again to give back all of $1's stars and their $2 points.
al_shrine_reset_done: $1's stars return to the sky. Your points are yours to spend again.
al_shrine_choose: Choose what to ask for first.
al_soul_rises: A Soul of $1 rises where the boss fell
al_boon_gefjun_long_table_dream: You dream of a long table in a warm hall, heavy with bread and harvest. Gefjun fills your cup.
al_boon_vor_knowing_dream: You dream of a woman who asks you questions you somehow know the answers to. Vör smiles.
al_boon_baldur_shining_dream: You dream of a light so bright no shadow can stand in it. Baldur stands within it, unharmed.
al_boon_skadi_huntress_dream: You dream of snow, a bow in your hands, and tracks that never end. Skaði runs beside you.
al_boon_syn_threshold_dream: You dream of a great door, and you are its bar. Nothing passes. Syn nods.
al_boon_freya_sessrumnir_dream: You dream of a hall of many seats, and a falcon over the battlefield. Freyja chooses you.
al_boon_hel_harvest_dream: You dream of a cold hall where half the faces are dead. Hel shares her meal with you.
al_boon_vidarr_silent_vow_dream: You dream of a silent march through endless winter, and a great iron-shod boot. Víðarr says nothing.
al_dream_plain: $1 comes to you in a dream.
al_reason_root: That is the deity's own star; every path starts there.
al_reason_unlinked: That star doesn't link to one you have.
al_reason_strands: Other stars you have depend on that one.
al_cmd_usage_node: Usage: <deity> <node>. al-list <deity> shows the node ids.
al_cmd_usage_deity: Name a deity: Gefjun, Vor, Baldur, Skadi, Syn, Freyja or Hel.
al_cmd_no_powers: Your star maps give you no powers yet.
al_cmd_usage_boon: Usage: al-boon <deity> [blessing | dream [n]], or al-boon clear
al_cmd_no_boon: $1 has no such boon to lend.
al_cmd_boons_cleared: Every blessing and inspiration has ended.
al_cmd_no_quest: No boss is mapped to $1 in SoulBosses, so $1 has no quest.
al_cmd_deeds_chance: Every lucky chance is now $1% until al-deeds chance off.
al_cmd_deeds_chance_off: Lucky chances follow the server's settings again.
al_cmd_dream_none: No deity can send you a dream yet: each needs $1 star points earned with it.
al_cmd_dream_forced: Your next sleep brings a dream from one of these (points earned): $1
al_cmd_locks_off: The progression lock is off (EnableProgressionLock); nothing is sealed.
al_cmd_locks_level_personal: Seals open with the bosses you have helped defeat. The last one: $1.
al_cmd_locks_level_world: Seals open with the bosses defeated in this world or by you. The last one: $1.
al_cmd_locks_unknown: No item or build piece is called $1.
al_cmd_locks_dump: Wrote $1 sealed items and pieces to the log by boss, and $2 that are never sealed.
al_cmd_server_not_admin: The server doesn't list you as an admin.
al_cmd_player_ambiguous: More than one player online is called $1.
al_cmd_player_away: $1 is between bodies; try again once they are back.
al_cmd_player_map_reset: $1's $2 star map was reset, as their points no longer covered its stars.
al_points_map_reset: Your $1 star map is reset; spend what is left again.
al_power_dormant: dormant: $1 waiting for a major star to switch it on
al_starmap_hint_locked: Click a star to take it  -  Spent points stay locked until reset at the deity's shrine  -  Drag to move  -  Wheel to zoom  -  Esc to close
al_starmap_locked: Taken. Its points stay spent until you reset $1's stars at $1's shrine.
al_power_HarvestBounty_desc: $1% chance of an extra harvest when picking
al_power_HarvestBounty_details: Works on berries, mushrooms, crops, flowers and other picked plants, dropping a full second helping beside the plant. Pickups that are treasure or materials, such as stone, flint, wood, amber, coins and surtling cores, never count.
al_power_FishingProsperity_desc: $1% chance of a bonus find when you land a fish
al_power_FishingProsperity_details: Rolled each time you land a fish, and the find goes straight to your bag, or to your feet if it is full. Most finds are flint or coins, and a higher chance opens rarer ones: serpent scales from 10%, amber and rubies from 15%, amber pearls from 25% and silver necklaces from 35%.
al_power_FoodBonus_desc: Food gives $1% more health, stamina and eitr
al_power_FoodBonus_details: Raises only what each food adds, for as long as it lasts, not the base health and stamina you have without eating. Eitr from food is raised too.
al_power_Armor_details: A flat amount added to your body armor, so it counts even when you wear no gear. Any percentage cut to your armor is applied after it.
al_power_CarryWeight_details: A flat amount added to your carry limit, on top of belts and any other carry bonus you have.
al_power_SkillXp_details: Every skill learns faster from each use, combat and non-combat alike. It multiplies with your other experience bonuses.
al_power_SkillEcho_desc: $1% chance to gain skill experience twice
al_power_SkillEcho_details: Rolled separately for every gain of any skill. A success doubles that gain, with your other experience bonuses included.
al_power_BladeboundKnowledge_desc: $1% chance that combat skill experience also trains a non-combat skill
al_power_BladeboundKnowledge_details: Rolled each time a weapon skill, blocking, dodging or magic gains experience. On a success a random non-combat skill, from running and jumping to cooking and riding, gains experience as if you had used it.
al_power_RecipeInsight_desc: $1% chance that a new recipe trains a random skill
al_power_RecipeInsight_details: Rolled each time you learn a recipe you did not know before. On a success one random skill gains as much experience as five ordinary uses of it, with your experience bonuses applied.
al_power_KnowledgeIsPower_desc: Combat skills gain $1% of your best non-combat skill as extra levels, up to 10
al_power_KnowledgeIsPower_details: Your best non-combat skill, such as running, woodcutting or cooking, lends extra levels to every weapon skill, blocking, dodging and magic. The extra levels count wherever the skill level matters, but never add more than 10.
al_power_UndeadDamage_details: Counts every creature of the undead, such as draugr, skeletons and ghosts, and every kind of hit you land on them: melee, ranged and magic.
al_power_FireAndPoisonResist_desc: $1% less damage from burning and poison
al_power_FireAndPoisonResist_details: Fire and poison that reach you are dealt over time as burning and poison, and this cuts that damage whatever its source, creatures, traps or open flames. It works alongside your other resistances.
al_power_BlockPower_details: Raises the block power of every shield and weapon you block with, and item tooltips show the stronger value. Parries gain from it too, since a parry multiplies your block power.
al_power_ArrowCatcher_desc: Every fifth ranged hit you take does $1% less damage
al_power_ArrowCatcher_details: Counts every ranged hit that reaches you, arrows, bolts, spells and area blasts alike, from all attackers together, but not hits you dodge. The fifth one is softened, then the count starts again.
al_power_StormRage_desc: In storms your hits deal $1% extra as lightning, or as frost in snowstorms
al_power_StormRage_details: Thunderstorms, snowstorms and any other weather the game calls a storm count. The extra is a share of each hit you land on a creature, melee or ranged, after your other damage bonuses.
al_power_ShadowSpeed_desc: +$1% run speed at night, in the mountains and in the Deep North
al_power_ShadowSpeed_details: Only sprinting is faster. Night follows the world's clock and counts anywhere, while the Mountains and the Deep North count by day as well.
al_power_ArrowScavenge_desc: $1% chance to get back an arrow or bolt when you kill while holding a bow or crossbow
al_power_ArrowScavenge_details: Rolled on each of your kills while you hold a bow or crossbow, never on tames or players. One of the arrows or bolts you have equipped goes straight into your bag, unless it is full.
al_power_StaggerThreshold_desc: It takes $1% more to stagger you
al_power_StaggerThreshold_details: Stagger builds from the damage you take, hits you block included, and you need more of it before you stumble. The threshold still grows with your max health as usual.
al_power_StaggeredDamageReduction_detail: Applies to every hit that lands while you are reeling from a stagger, whatever its source.
al_power_TowerBlockPower_details: Counts only for shields that cannot parry, the tower shields, and adds to any other block power bonus you have. Item tooltips show the stronger value.
al_power_LootWealth_desc: $1% chance that your kills drop coins or valuables
al_power_LootWealth_details: Rolled on each creature you kill, bosses included, never tames or players. Most often a handful of 3 to 15 coins drops, sometimes amber, an amber pearl, a ruby or a silver necklace instead.
al_power_MeleeDamage_details: Melee is any hit that is not a projectile or an area blast: weapon swings and fists alike. Only hits on creatures count, not chopping, mining or damage to buildings.
al_power_RangedDamage_details: Ranged is any projectile or area blast: arrows, bolts, thrown spears, staff spells and their explosions. Only hits on creatures count.
al_power_AllDamage_details: Applies to every hit you land on a creature, melee, ranged or magic, and multiplies with your other damage bonuses. Chopping, mining and damage to buildings are unaffected.
al_power_ExecuteDamage_details: Any creature counts once its health falls under 30%, bosses included, and every kind of hit gains: melee, ranged and magic.
al_power_FrostResist_details: Cuts the frost part of every hit that reaches you, from drakes, frost spells and the like. The cold of freezing weather is not frost damage and is not reduced.
al_power_EitrBase_details: Added straight to your max eitr on top of what food gives, so you have some eitr even without eating eitr food.
al_power_EitrRegen_details: Your eitr refills faster whenever it is below full. It multiplies with resting, meads and any other regeneration bonus you have.
al_power_StaminaRegen_details: Your stamina refills faster whenever it is below full. It multiplies with resting, meads and any other regeneration bonus you have.
al_power_HealthRegen_details: Multiplies the healing your food gives every 10 seconds, along with resting and any other regeneration bonus. Healing from meads, spells and other powers is unaffected.
al_power_PerfectForm_desc: About every 500 damage you deal, one hit does $1% more
al_power_PerfectForm_details: Every hit you land on a creature adds its base damage to a charge, whatever the target. The hit that fills the charge to 500 gets the bonus, and the charge starts again from nothing.
al_power_HealOnKill_desc: Kills heal you for $1% of your max health
al_power_HealOnKill_details: Any creature you kill counts, bosses included and foes your burning or poison finishes off, but not tames or other players.
al_power_HeatResistance_details: Slows the heat that builds near lava, under the Ashlands sun and in its scalding sea, and softens the burns that heat deals. It adds to the heat resistance of your gear, but can never make you immune on its own.
al_power_StaminaWhenHit_desc: Gain $1 stamina when a hit hurts you
al_power_StaminaWhenHit_details: Only hits that actually lower your health count, falls included. Hits you fully block or dodge, burning and poison ticks, and harm you deal yourself give nothing.
al_power_EitrWhenHit_desc: Gain $1 eitr when a hit hurts you
al_power_EitrWhenHit_details: Only hits that actually lower your health count, falls included. Hits you fully block or dodge, burning and poison ticks, and harm you deal yourself give nothing.
al_power_SpeedOnKill_desc: Kills give you $1% movement speed for 5 seconds
al_power_SpeedOnKill_details: Any kill counts except tames and players. Each kill restarts the 5 seconds rather than stacking, and the boost covers walking and running, at half strength while swimming.
al_power_DamageTaken_details: Every hit that reaches you is stronger, whether from creatures, other players, falls or freezing cold, and the fire or poison it carries grows with it.
al_power_LessDamageDealt_details: Cuts every hit you land on a creature, melee, ranged and magic alike, after all your bonuses. Chopping, mining, damage to buildings and the strikes your powers set off are not reduced.
al_power_LessBluntDamage_details: Only the blunt part of each hit on a creature is cut, so clubs, sledges and fists suffer most. Other damage on the same hit, such as fire or poison, is untouched.
al_power_LessPierceDamage_details: Only the pierce part of each hit on a creature is cut, so arrows, bolts, spears and polearms suffer most. Other damage on the same hit is untouched.
al_power_LessSlashDamage_details: Only the slash part of each hit on a creature is cut, so swords and axes suffer most. Other damage on the same hit is untouched.
al_power_SkillGainPenalty_details: Every skill, combat and non-combat, learns more slowly from each use. It applies after all your experience bonuses, a doubled gain included.
al_power_CombatSkillGainPenalty_details: Affects weapon skills, blocking, dodging and both kinds of magic, while non-combat skills learn as before. It stacks with any other experience penalty.
al_power_DeathSkillLoss_desc: Lose $1% more skill when you die
al_power_DeathSkillLoss_details: Raises the share of every skill you lose when you die. A death while the grace from an earlier death still guards your skills costs nothing, as usual.
al_power_MaxHealthPenalty_details: Cuts your whole max health, base health, food and blessings together, not only what food gives.
al_power_MaxStaminaPenalty_details: Cuts your whole max stamina, base stamina, food and blessings together, not only what food gives.
al_power_MaxEitrPenalty_details: Cuts your whole max eitr, from food and from flat eitr blessings alike, so you can cast less before running dry.
al_power_CarryWeightPenalty_details: A flat amount taken off your carry limit, whatever belts or other carry bonuses you have.
al_power_FoodDurationPenalty_details: Each food's timer runs down faster, so it fades and needs replacing sooner. Its healing still comes every 10 seconds while it lasts.
al_power_NoBows_details: You cannot equip any bow, and one in your hands is put away the moment the oath is taken. Crossbows are not covered by this oath.
al_power_NoCrossbows_details: You cannot equip any crossbow, and one in your hands is put away the moment the oath is taken. Bows are not covered by this oath.
al_power_FarmingXp_details: It applies to the Farming skill alone, however you raise it, and multiplies with your other skill experience bonuses rather than adding to them.
al_power_SeedsOfTheGods_desc: Crops you plant grow in any biome, heat or cold
al_power_SeedsOfTheGods_details: Any crop or sapling you sow while you hold this keeps the gift for good, even if you later lose the star or someone else tends it. Plants still need open sky, room to grow, and tilled soil where the seed asks for it.
al_power_GatherYield_desc: $1% chance that a hit on a tree, rock or ore throws off an extra piece
al_power_GatherYield_details: Each hit that harms a tree, log, stump, rock or ore deposit rolls the chance, and your tool must be strong enough to work it. The extra piece is one of whatever that source drops, such as wood, stone or ore.
al_power_FoodDuration_details: Every food you have eaten burns down more slowly, so the health, stamina and eitr it gives also fade later; at 100% food lasts twice as long. Meads aren't food and aren't affected.
al_power_HeartyMeal_desc: Your strongest food gives $1% more health
al_power_HeartyMeal_details: Only health is raised, not stamina or eitr, and only from whichever of your current foods gives the most health right now. As that food burns down, the bonus shrinks with it.
al_power_FeastShare_desc: Eating heals players within 6 m for $1% of the food's health
al_power_FeastShare_details: Only food counts, not meads, and the heal lands at once on every other living player within 6 m, not on you. It is a share of the food's full listed health.
al_power_BlockStamina_details: It works on every block, with a shield or a weapon, parries included. Blocks that would give stamina back are left as they are.
al_power_Shelter_details: Your health is checked just before each hit lands, and the cut comes after armor, so it works on every kind of damage, from blows to fire, poison and falls.
al_power_Fortification_desc: Each Fortification stack means $1% less damage taken; up to 5 stacks, lasting 10 seconds
al_power_Fortification_details: Stacks come from other powers, such as blocking under Mother's Ward. Each new stack restarts the 10 seconds for all of them, and however many you hold, Fortification never takes more than half off a hit.
al_power_CheatDeath_desc: Once every 10 minutes a killing blow leaves you at 1 health and roots enemies within 6 m for 3 seconds
al_power_CheatDeath_details: It catches killing blows from falls and poison as well as foes, after armor and your other protections, and it is tried before Death's Bargain or an ally's Last Door. Only enemies are rooted, never players or tames, and dying doesn't reset the 10 minutes.
al_power_FurrowSlam_desc: A two-handed weapon's secondary attack cuts a furrow 8 m ahead, striking each enemy along it for $1% of the weapon's damage
al_power_FurrowSlam_details: The furrow bursts 0.6 seconds into the swing along a strip 3 m wide, hitting each enemy once with blunt damage and knockback. It counts the weapon's own damage, not your skill or other damage powers, and weapons that shoot don't plough.
al_power_HearthAura_desc: Players within 8 m gain $1% of your food health
al_power_HearthAura_details: It counts the health your food gives right now and adds that share to their max health, so it shrinks as your food burns down. You don't gain it yourself, and with several Hearth-Mothers nearby only the largest share counts.
al_power_MothersWard_desc: Each block builds a stack of Fortification
al_power_MothersWard_details: Any block that stops some damage counts, parries included, with a shield or a weapon. Each block also restarts the 10 seconds on the stacks you already hold, so steady blocking keeps them up.
al_power_NonCombatSkillXp_details: Every skill outside weapons, magic, blocking and dodging counts, such as woodcutting, mining, running, sneaking, swimming, fishing, cooking, farming, crafting and riding. It multiplies with your other experience bonuses.
al_power_Eureka_desc: $1% chance that a skill level-up brings a second level
al_power_Eureka_details: Any skill can bring it, but never past level 100. The bonus level starts with no progress toward the next, and it doesn't set off Völuspá or another Eureka.
al_power_ExploreRadius_desc: You reveal the map $1% farther around you
al_power_ExploreRadius_details: It widens only the reveal around you as you travel. Raven's Eye and maps shared with you aren't widened.
al_power_Stealth_desc: You are $1% harder to notice while sneaking
al_power_Stealth_details: It only works while you crouch, shortening how far creatures can spot you by sight. The noise you make is unchanged.
al_power_OreSense_desc: Ore within $1 m is marked on your map
al_power_OreSense_details: Deposits that yield ore, scrap or obsidian count, from copper and tin to muddy scrap piles and silver veins. The marks refresh every 3 seconds, vanish when you move away or the deposit is gone, and are never saved.
al_power_SeeressMap_desc: Chests, dungeon entrances and creatures of two stars or more within $1 m are marked on your map
al_power_SeeressMap_details: Only chests that came with the world and still hold something are marked, and creature marks follow their creature. Marks refresh every 3 seconds, fade once out of range, and are never saved.
al_power_Tracks_desc: The last creature you hit stays marked on your map for a minute
al_power_Tracks_details: The mark follows the creature and fades when it dies or a minute passes without you hitting it. Hitting something else moves the mark to that target.
al_power_RavensEye_desc: Once a minute, the map is revealed $1 m around you
al_power_RavensEye_details: It works wherever you are, even standing still, starting as soon as you hold it. Far Sight doesn't widen it.
al_power_CritChance_desc: $1% chance for a hit to be critical, dealing 50% more
al_power_CritChance_details: Every hit you land on a creature rolls, melee, ranged or magic, while extra hits made by other powers never do. A critical multiplies the whole hit, along with your other damage bonuses.
al_power_CritDamage_details: It adds to the base 50% of a critical hit, so +50% here makes criticals deal double. It does nothing while you hold Certain Blow, whose criticals are fixed at 25%.
al_power_LearnedFromFallen_desc: Killing a starred creature gives $1% more damage per star for 20 seconds
al_power_LearnedFromFallen_details: Only your own kills of creatures with at least one star count, foes your burning or poison finishes included. Each starred kill restarts the 20 seconds and keeps whichever bonus is larger, and the bonus raises every hit you deal.
al_power_CertainBlow_desc: Every hit is critical, but critical hits deal only 25% more
al_power_CertainBlow_details: Every hit you land on a creature is critical, but a critical is fixed at 25% more, so your critical chance and critical damage powers stop mattering.
al_power_Foresight_desc: An enemy's first hit on you misses, and does again once it has gone 20 seconds without hitting you
al_power_Foresight_details: Each attacker is tracked on its own, and the miss also cancels the blow's knockback, stagger and any ailment it carries. A blow you would have dodged still uses it up.
al_power_Unveiling_desc: Each hit marks the enemy for 6 seconds; you deal $1% more damage to it per mark, up to 5
al_power_Unveiling_details: A hit counts the marks already there before adding its own, so the first hit gains nothing. Each hit within 6 seconds keeps the marks; leave the enemy untouched for 6 seconds and they all fade.
al_power_Voluspa_desc: A skill level-up gives $1% more damage and skill experience for 10 seconds
al_power_Voluspa_details: Any skill going up counts, fighting or not. Another level-up inside the window restarts the 10 seconds rather than stacking, and the damage covers every hit you land on a foe.
al_power_SpiritDamage_details: Added to every hit you land with a weapon, arrow or spell, after your other bonuses, so critical hits don't raise it. Like silver's spirit damage, it burns in over a few seconds. Bursts and strikes from other powers don't carry it.
al_power_Sunstrike_desc: Critical hits on undead call down light for $1% of the hit as spirit damage
al_power_Sunstrike_details: Critical hits come from other powers, such as Studious, Certain Blow or First Cut; without one this never fires. The light is a separate spirit strike on the same undead foe, sized from the hit's damage before your bonuses.
al_power_CleansingFlame_desc: Undead you kill burst into light, hitting enemies within 4 m for $1% of its health, half as fire and half as spirit
al_power_CleansingFlame_details: Only undead you kill count, foes your burning or poison finishes included. The burst's damage is split evenly between fire and spirit, and a boss counts as having at most 1000 health.
al_power_WetResist_details: It doesn't keep you dry: rain and water still soak you, but once you are out of them the wet wears off sooner.
al_power_CleanParry_desc: A parry removes one ailment: burning, poison, frost, shock, spirit, wet, smoke or tar
al_power_CleanParry_details: Each parry clears the first ailment you have, checked in the order listed, so burning goes before poison. The parry must actually block damage, and tower shields can't parry.
al_power_PoisonImmunity_details: The poison ailment can never take hold of you, and the poison part of any hit is removed. The rest of a poisoned blow, such as its pierce or blunt damage, still lands.
al_power_ParryWindow_details: Normally a block only counts as a parry if you raised your guard within a quarter second of the hit; this stretches that window. It works with any shield or weapon that can parry, but tower shields still can't.
al_power_ReturnedLight_desc: Parrying a projectile strikes the shooter for $1% of the blocked damage as spirit
al_power_ReturnedLight_details: Only ranged hits count, such as arrows and spells. The shooter is struck wherever they stand, however far away, and the parry must actually block damage.
al_power_AllThings_desc: The first hit every 20 seconds is ignored
al_power_AllThings_details: Only hits from creatures or other players count, so falls, burning and drowning don't use it up, but a hit you dodge or block does. The ignored hit also loses its knockback, stagger and any ailment it carried.
al_power_Invincible_desc: When a hit drops you below 20% health, nothing can hurt you for 3 seconds; once every 5 minutes
al_power_Invincible_details: The hit that sets it off still lands, and a blow that would kill you outright doesn't trigger it. For those 3 seconds every kind of damage is ignored, burning and falls included, and dying doesn't reset the 5 minutes.
al_power_Dawnbringer_desc: A light surrounds you, and undead within 6 m take $1 spirit damage each second
al_power_Dawnbringer_details: Only undead are hurt; living creatures are untouched. The light itself reaches about 10 m around you and is seen only on your own screen.
al_power_BrightRetort_desc: A parry staggers every enemy within 4 m
al_power_BrightRetort_details: Every creature within 4 m of you other than players and tames is staggered, not just the one you parried. The parry must actually block damage, so tower shields never set it off.
al_power_BowDamage_details: Only hits with a bow count; crossbows and thrown spears don't. It multiplies with your other damage bonuses, such as ranged damage.
al_power_DrawSpeed_details: A full draw, with its full damage and range, comes sooner. Only bows draw, so crossbow reloading is unchanged.
al_power_PiercingShot_desc: Arrows also hit the nearest enemy behind the target for $1% of the hit
al_power_PiercingShot_details: Only arrows from a bow count. The extra hit goes to the one closest enemy within 4 m beyond the target, along the arrow's flight, and uses the arrow's damage before your bonuses, dealt as pierce.
al_power_FieldDressing_desc: What creatures you kill with a bow or crossbow drop goes into your bag
al_power_FieldDressing_details: For 15 seconds after the kill, anything that drops within 3 m of the body is picked up for you. Only what fell after the kill is taken, and items stay on the ground while your bag is full.
al_power_ExtraArrows_desc: Bows loose $1 extra arrows, spread a little wider
al_power_ExtraArrows_details: The extra arrows cost no ammunition and each one hits for full damage. Only bows count, not crossbows.
al_power_FrostDamage_details: Added to every hit you land with a weapon, arrow or spell, after your other bonuses, so critical hits don't raise it. The frost also chills what it hits, slowing it for a while.
al_power_Shatter_desc: Enemies killed by a frost hit shatter, hitting enemies within 4 m for $1% of their health as frost
al_power_Shatter_details: The killing blow must carry frost damage, which Rime adds to every hit. A boss counts as having at most 1000 health, and anything the burst kills can shatter in turn.
al_power_ColdImmunity_desc: Cold and freezing can't touch you
al_power_ColdImmunity_details: You never become cold or freezing, in any biome, by day or night. Frost damage and the slowing chill of frost attacks still reach you.
al_power_JumpHeight_details: Raises every jump you make, including the second jump from Mountain-born, and Leap multiplies with it while you sprint.
al_power_RunStamina_details: Only sprinting counts; walking, jumping and other actions cost as before. In the mountains and the Deep North it multiplies with Skis of Skaði.
al_power_SureFooted_details: No drop is too high: landings never hurt, however far you fall. Because of that, a landing never sets off Víðarr's Heel-stamp.
al_power_Skis_desc: In the mountains and the Deep North, running costs $1% less stamina and you move faster by a fifth of that
al_power_Skis_details: It works anywhere in those two biomes, on snow or bare rock, and multiplies with Long Stride. You also move faster there, by a fifth of that figure, walking as well as running.
al_power_Leap_details: Only jumps made while sprinting count, and it multiplies with Light Step. Jumps from a walk or a standstill use Light Step alone.
al_power_DoubleJump_details: Press jump again in the air for a second jump at nine tenths of a normal jump's strength, costing the usual stamina. You get one per leap, renewed on landing, and not while attacking, dodging, swimming, staggered or over-encumbered.
al_power_HangOnTheWind_desc: Drawing a bow in mid-air all but stops your fall
al_power_HangOnTheWind_details: While you draw a bow in mid-air you sink no faster than 0.3 m a second and your drift slows. A fall is measured only from where you stop hanging, so landing straight after takes no damage.
al_power_WintersShatter_desc: Bow and crossbow kills burst into frost, hitting enemies within 6 m for $1% of the victim's health
al_power_WintersShatter_details: Bow and crossbow kills both count, whatever the victim was. The burst is frost damage, and a boss counts as having at most 1000 health.
al_power_WolfSister_desc: Three bow or crossbow kills within 20 seconds call a wolf to hunt beside you for a minute
al_power_WolfSister_details: Bow and crossbow kills both count, and the tally starts over once a wolf comes. The wolf follows you as a tame, and your powers can keep at most three called creatures at once unless another power raises the limit.
al_power_Footing_desc: While blocking, stagger is paid with stamina when you have enough
al_power_Footing_details: Each point of stagger you would take with your guard up costs half a point of stamina instead. If you lack the stamina, the stagger builds as usual, and a heavy blow can still break your guard.
al_power_Unstaggerable_details: No blow, blocked or not, builds any stagger on you, so you are never knocked off balance and a block only gives way when your stamina runs out.
al_power_BrutalDefiance_desc: Every third block within 6 seconds releases a burst, hitting enemies within 3 m for $1% of your block power
al_power_BrutalDefiance_details: Only blocks that hold count, parries included, and the count starts over after each burst. The burst is blunt damage with a shove, measured against the block power of whatever you block with at your Blocking skill, without any parry bonus.
al_power_SealedWall_desc: Blocking with a tower shield turns aside $1% of elemental, poison and spirit damage
al_power_SealedWall_details: Only shields that cannot parry count as tower shields. Physical damage is left to the block itself, and the cut applies whenever the shield is raised, even to a blow that comes from behind.
al_power_ThornsOnBlock_desc: Blocking strikes the attacker for $1% of the damage blocked
al_power_ThornsOnBlock_details: The blow comes back as blunt damage and finds the attacker wherever it stands, so archers feel it too. Parries count as well, and only the damage your block actually stopped is measured.
al_power_StrengthOfValkyries_desc: Each weapon skill counts as higher by $1% of your best other weapon skill, up to 10 levels
al_power_StrengthOfValkyries_details: Your highest weapon skill borrows from your second highest, and every other weapon skill borrows from your highest. Swords, knives, clubs, polearms, spears, axes, bows, crossbows and unarmed count, but magic and blocking don't. The extra levels work wherever the skill matters, while your trained level stays the same.
al_power_Challenge_desc: Creatures you hit turn on you
al_power_Challenge_details: Every hit you land, melee, ranged or magic, makes a creature drop whatever it was after, another player, a tame or a building, and turn on you instead. This works on bosses too.
al_power_RuneDome_desc: While you block, a rune dome covers players within 4 m, who take $1% less damage
al_power_RuneDome_details: The dome covers you too, but not tames, and cuts damage of every kind. You only need to hold your guard up, not block the hit, and where domes from several players overlap only the strongest counts.
al_power_StoneSkin_desc: Standing still for a second fills your Fortification
al_power_StoneSkin_details: After a full second standing still on the ground you gain all 5 stacks at once. It fires once per stand and the stacks fade 10 seconds later, so shift your feet and plant them again to renew it.
al_power_LastDoor_desc: Once every 5 minutes, you take the killing blow meant for a player within 10 m
al_power_LastDoor_details: It only steps in when your ally has no death-saving power of their own ready. The blow lands on you in full as untyped damage your armor does not soften, and the 5 minute wait begins only when you take one; dying doesn't reset it.
al_power_MagicDamage_details: It counts for every hit from Elemental Magic and Blood Magic staffs, but not for the creatures those staffs call up.
al_power_SpellEcho_desc: $1% chance that a spell casts again at once, for free
al_power_SpellEcho_details: Only Elemental Magic and Blood Magic attacks that launch projectiles can echo, and the chance is rolled for each burst a staff fires. The echo costs no eitr and never echoes again.
al_power_StormWeave_desc: In rain or water, your lightning arcs to wet enemies within 6 m for $1% of its damage
al_power_StormWeave_details: Any hit of yours that carries lightning counts, whether from a staff, a weapon or another power. In rain every enemy near the target is struck; out of the rain only enemies standing in water are, and only when the target is in water too. The arcs never chain further.
al_power_BloodSeidr_desc: When eitr runs short, spells take the rest from your health
al_power_BloodSeidr_details: Health pays point for point for the eitr you lack and never takes you below 1, so a spell can't kill you, and you can keep casting with an empty eitr pool.
al_power_AttackStamina_details: Covers every weapon and tool attack, special attacks included, and the stamina drained while you hold a bow drawn. It multiplies with savings for particular weapons.
al_power_BattleFury_desc: Each hit builds fury, $1% more damage per stack up to 20; it fades after 4 seconds without a hit
al_power_BattleFury_details: Every hit you land adds a stack, melee, ranged or magic, and each stack counts from your next hit on. All stacks drop at once when 4 seconds pass without a hit.
al_power_DodgeStamina_details: Applies to every dodge roll and multiplies with anything else that changes what a dodge costs, oaths included.
al_power_JumpStamina_desc: Jumping from the ground costs $1% less stamina
al_power_JumpStamina_details: Applies to ordinary jumps from the ground. If you can jump again in mid-air, that second jump always costs full stamina.
al_power_FalconGlide_desc: Hold jump while falling to glide
al_power_FalconGlide_details: While you hold jump in the air you fall no faster than 2 m a second, at no stamina cost, and landing within a second of gliding takes no fall damage. It does not work in water.
al_power_Beloved_desc: The effect of anything you consume, meads above all, also reaches players within 6 m
al_power_Beloved_details: Other living players within 6 m get the effect fresh from the start without spending anything of their own. Anything you consume that carries an effect is shared, not only meads.
al_power_BattleMedic_desc: While you block, other players within 5 m heal $1 health a second
al_power_BattleMedic_details: It heals other players only, not you or your tames, once a second for as long as your guard is up, whether or not anything strikes it.
al_power_ChargedGrace_desc: A dodge or parry charges your next hit: $1% more damage, and half the hit splashes onto enemies close by
al_power_ChargedGrace_details: The charge waits for your next hit of any kind, even after its icon fades, and a second dodge or parry adds nothing. The splash is blunt damage worth half the hit before bonuses, striking enemies within 2.5 m of the target.
al_power_Folkvangr_desc: $1% chance that a kill calls an einherjar to fight beside you for 20 seconds
al_power_Folkvangr_details: The einherjar is a skeleton warrior that follows you and fights at your side. Your powers can keep at most three such helpers at once unless another power allows more, and a kill past that limit calls no one.
al_power_Brisingamen_desc: While your eitr is above half, it takes damage before your health
al_power_Brisingamen_details: Only eitr above the halfway mark is spent, one point for each point of damage that gets past your armor and other protections, and whatever it can't cover falls on your health.
al_power_FalconForm_desc: Hold jump to hover, at a cost in stamina
al_power_FalconForm_details: While you hold jump in the air you stop sinking, at 6 stamina a second. When your stamina runs dry you drop, or glide if you have Falcon Glide, and landing within a second of hovering takes no fall damage.
al_power_FireResist_details: Cuts the fire in every hit on you before armor, so the burning it leaves behind is weaker too. It works on top of fire resistance from meads and gear.
al_power_Retort_desc: Taking fire damage wraps you in flame for 5 seconds, burning enemies within 3 m for $1 a second
al_power_Retort_details: Fire in a hit sets you burning, and each burning tick sets it off and restarts the 5 seconds; a dodged or fully blocked hit sets nothing alight. The flames pulse once a second, reach bosses too and don't set off your on-hit powers.
al_power_Wildfire_desc: Enemies that die burning spread the fire, hitting enemies within 4 m for $1% of their health
al_power_Wildfire_details: Burning from any source counts, the killing blow's own fire included, and a foe that burns to death after your hit is your kill too. A boss counts as at most 1000 health.
al_power_PyreOfHelheim_desc: You burn, losing 1% health a second down to 1; your fire damage is half again as strong and Ashlands heat can't hurt you
al_power_PyreOfHelheim_details: The burn ignores armor and every other protection, and never stops while you hold the star. Only fire on your own weapon, bow and spell hits is strengthened, not bursts or auras, and lava, the boiling Ashlands sea and the Ashlands sun build no heat on you.
al_power_LifeLeech_desc: Heal for $1% of the damage you deal
al_power_LifeLeech_details: Counts the whole hit as it leaves you, after your damage bonuses but before the target's armor or resistances. Any weapon, bow or spell hit heals you; bursts, auras and other side effects don't.
al_power_StoredForLater_desc: Healing beyond your max health builds Fortification
al_power_StoredForLater_details: A heal counts only if it overflows your max health by at least 5 and you weren't already full. Each such heal adds one Fortification stack and renews how long your stacks last.
al_power_DeathsBargain_desc: Once an hour a killing blow leaves you at 1 health; kill something within 15 seconds or die
al_power_DeathsBargain_details: Bloom of Zealand is used first if it's ready, and the bargain is spent before an ally's Last Door can take the blow. Any kill of yours counts, a foe your burning or poison finishes included, and if time runs out nothing can save you. Dying doesn't reset the hour.
al_power_SilentPassing_desc: A dodge soon after a kill makes you silent and hard to notice for 5 seconds
al_power_SilentPassing_details: The dodge must come within 3 seconds of one of your kills, and each such dodge starts the 5 seconds again. Meanwhile you make no noise, and while sneaking you are half as easy to spot.
al_power_OpenWound_desc: Hits make enemies bleed for $1% of the hit; one that dies bleeding bursts, hitting enemies within 4 m for $1% of its health
al_power_OpenWound_details: Bleeding and the burst are both poison, so poison-immune foes ignore them, and the bleed is a share of the hit before your damage bonuses. An enemy counts as bleeding for 5 seconds after your last hit on it or while the poison lasts, so the bleed itself can finish it; a boss counts as at most 1000 health.
al_power_SpiritImmunity_details: Every hit on you loses its spirit damage before it lands, whatever the source. The rest of the hit still gets through as normal.
al_power_Naglfar_desc: $1% chance that a kill raises a thrall to fight beside you for 20 seconds; badly hurt, it bursts into fire
al_power_Naglfar_details: Only your own kills can raise one, foes your burning or poison finishes included. The thrall is a skeleton that rises where the enemy fell, and below a quarter health it bursts for fire worth a third of its max health on enemies within 3 m. Your powers keep at most three summons at once between them, more with Legion.
al_power_QueensDecree_desc: Enemies below $1% health die to your next hit, bosses excepted
al_power_QueensDecree_details: Any weapon, bow or spell hit can do it: the blow adds twice the enemy's remaining health as damage that armor and resistances can't reduce. Bursts, auras and other side effects can't execute.
al_power_MoveSpeedPenalty_details: Walking, running and swimming are all slower, and the cut multiplies with every speed bonus you have.
al_power_StaminaRegenPenalty_details: Your stamina refills more slowly, multiplied in with any regeneration bonus. Stamina you gain in other ways, such as from powers, is unaffected.
al_power_EitrRegenPenalty_details: Your eitr refills more slowly, multiplied in with any regeneration bonus. Eitr you gain in other ways, such as from powers, is unaffected.
al_power_HealthRegenPenalty_details: Cuts the healing your food gives every 10 seconds, and at its fullest your food heals you not at all. Healing from meads, spells and powers is unaffected.
al_power_NightDamagePenalty_details: Cuts every hit you land on a creature while it is night. Night follows the world's clock, so caves and dungeons count too.
al_power_NoPoisonDealt_desc: Your hits deal no poison damage
al_power_NoPoisonDealt_details: Strips the poison from every hit you land, poisoned weapons, arrows and bombs included. Bursts and auras your powers set off are separate and still poison.
al_power_PierceDamageTaken_details: The pierce part of every hit that reaches you is stronger: arrows, bolts, spears and other piercing attacks. Slash, blunt and elemental damage are unchanged.
al_power_FireDamageTaken_details: The fire part of every hit that reaches you is stronger, and so is the burning it leaves on you. It multiplies with any fire resistance you have.
al_power_NoSneak_details: Pressing crouch does nothing, so you cannot sneak or train the Sneak skill. Enemies that have not noticed you still take sneak attack damage.
al_power_BowDamagePenalty_details: Cuts every hit you land with a bow, after all your bonuses. Crossbows, thrown spears and spells are unaffected.
al_power_DrawSpeedPenalty_details: Your bow takes longer to reach a full draw, so hurried shots fly weaker. Crossbow reloading is unaffected.
al_power_MeleeDamagePenalty_details: Cuts every hit you land that is not a projectile or an area blast, weapon swings and fists alike. Arrows, bolts, thrown spears and spells are unaffected.
al_power_ArmorPenalty_details: Cuts your total armor after everything else is added up, the armor from your gear and from flat armor blessings together.
al_lastdoor_saved: $1 took the blow meant for you
al_lastdoor_taken: You took a blow meant for an ally
al_looks_hint: Each deity's looks come with their stars. Step through the deities you have a look from, or choose None.
al_looks_none_yet: Major, oath-bound and apex stars bring their deity's looks.
al_ascend_desc: Begin again in $1's name, higher in their favour.
al_ascend_souls: Every boss's Soul of Power can be claimed again.
al_ascend_cost_keys: Every boss must be defeated again, by everyone in this world.
al_ascend_confirm: Ascension can't be undone. Offer again to ascend.
al_power_TamingSpeed_desc: Creatures within 30 m of you tame $1% faster
al_power_TamingSpeed_details: Taming still only moves forward while the creature is fed and calm. With several players nearby, only the strongest bonus counts.
al_power_TameGuard_desc: Tames within 20 m of you take $1% less damage
al_power_TameGuard_details: Any tamed creature counts, yours or another player's, and it eases every kind of damage it takes. With several players nearby, only the strongest bonus counts.
al_power_FruitfulHerd_desc: Tames within 30 m of you breed and grow up $1% faster
al_power_FruitfulHerd_details: Tames try to breed more often and carry their young for less time, and the young grow up sooner. Any player's tames count, the usual breeding needs still apply, and only the strongest bonus nearby counts.
al_power_DraughtOx_desc: Carts you or your tames pull are $1% lighter; crouch as you take a cart's handle to harness a tame following you to it
al_power_DraughtOx_details: The cart is lighter while you or a tame that follows you pulls it. To harness, crouch and take a free cart's handle: the nearest tame following you within 8 m of it is led into place, though summoned allies can't be harnessed.
al_power_HerdFed_desc: Tames within 30 m of you stay fed
al_power_HerdFed_details: Any player's tames count. Fed tames keep healing over time and can breed without eating, while creatures you are still taming must be fed as usual.
al_power_FourOxen_desc: Each tame within 20 m, up to four, gives +$1 carry weight and 4% less damage taken
al_power_FourOxen_details: Every living tame counts, yours or not, and the count updates each second. With four tames close by, you take 16% less damage from every hit.
al_power_RestedDuration_details: It lengthens both the base time and the extra time each comfort level adds, from the moment you become Rested or renew it.
al_power_Comfort_details: The bonus counts wherever you are, even outside shelter, so it lengthens Rested each time you rest and raises anything that reads your comfort, such as Hearth Strength.
al_power_StationSpeed_desc: Smelters, kilns, ovens, fermenters and cooking stations within 15 m of you work $1% faster
al_power_StationSpeed_details: Furnaces, kilns, the windmill, the spinning wheel and other refiners count, as do cooking stations, ovens and fermenters, whoever owns them. With several players nearby, only the strongest bonus counts.
al_power_HearthStrength_desc: While rested, each comfort level gives +$1% damage and stamina regeneration
al_power_HearthStrength_details: It reads the comfort around you right now, so it is strongest at home; out in the wild only your base level and comfort bonuses count. The damage applies to every hit you land on a foe.
al_power_Hermit_desc: +2 comfort; hives and crops within 30 m of your bed give 25% more
al_power_Hermit_details: Your bed is the one set as your spawn point, and the comfort counts wherever you are. Honey from hives within 30 m of that bed comes with a quarter more on average, and crops picked there have a one in four chance to come twice.
al_power_Swarm_desc: Bees sting enemies within 4 m of you every second, each sting a $1 dose of poison that renews rather than stacks; twice as strong within 30 m of a beehive
al_power_Swarm_details: Every second the bees poison each enemy within 4 m, never players or tames. Poison doesn't stack, so each sting renews the dose rather than adding to it, and any built beehive within 30 m of you doubles it.
al_power_ChopDamage_details: Only the chopping part of a hit is raised, so it helps axes and anything else that chops, on trees, logs, stumps and other wood. It does nothing against creatures.
al_power_MineDamage_details: Only the pickaxe part of a hit is raised, on rocks, ore deposits and anything else you mine. It does nothing against creatures.
al_power_ToolStamina_desc: Axes and pickaxes cost $1% less stamina
al_power_ToolStamina_details: It covers every swing of an axe or pickaxe, battleaxes included, in a fight as well as at work.
al_power_PathSpeed_desc: On paths, roads and tilled ground, move $1% faster and run for twice that less stamina
al_power_PathSpeed_details: Ground cleared into a path, cultivated or paved all counts, but only while your feet are on it. The speed covers walking, running and sneaking alike, and the stamina saving applies to running.
al_power_OverCarry_desc: Over your carry limit you don't slow down; the extra weight costs stamina instead
al_power_OverCarry_details: Each kilogram over the limit drains 0.1 stamina a second, and your stamina won't recover while you stay over. Once it runs out, the weight slows you as usual.
al_power_LoadStrength_desc: +$1% damage for every 25 kg you carry, up to 20%
al_power_LoadStrength_details: It counts the full weight of your inventory, worn gear included, in whole steps of 25 kg, and raises every hit you land on a foe, melee, ranged or magic.
al_power_DurabilityLoss_details: It gives back that share of the wear on everything you wear and hold, weapons, tools, shields and armor alike, as the wear happens.
al_power_MaxDurability_details: Every item that wears out holds more, tools included, and repairs fill it to the new maximum. It counts only while you hold the power.
al_power_CraftRefund_desc: $1% chance that crafting or upgrading costs nothing
al_power_CraftRefund_details: Anything made from a crafting menu counts, at any station, cauldron included, and upgrades too; when it triggers, the item is made and nothing is used up. Building doesn't count.
al_power_Masterwork_desc: $1% chance that a weapon or armor you craft or upgrade is a masterwork, with 10% more damage or armor
al_power_Masterwork_details: Weapons, shields and armor, capes included, can become masterworks; tools like the hammer can't. The mark stays when the item is upgraded or traded, an ordinary item rolls again on each upgrade, and a shield's block isn't raised.
al_power_WeaponLore_desc: Each weapon gains +$1% damage for every 50 kills made with it, up to 20%
al_power_WeaponLore_details: Kills count on the weapon in your hand when a creature dies to you, only while you hold this, and show in its tooltip. The tally stays with the weapon when traded or upgraded; bare fists earn nothing.
al_power_SneakAttack_details: It multiplies your weapon's own sneak attack bonus, so a sneak attack still needs an enemy that hasn't noticed you. Hits that Read the Fight turns into sneak attacks are raised too.
al_power_Weakness_desc: +$1% to each damage type a creature is weak to
al_power_Weakness_details: Slightly weak, weak and very weak all count, and only those damage types are raised. It works on every hit you land, melee, ranged or magic.
al_power_QuietKill_desc: Hitting an unaware enemy makes no noise, so killing it doesn't alert the others
al_power_QuietKill_details: For 1 second after you hit an enemy that hasn't noticed you, you make no noise at all, and neither does your arrow, bolt or spell where it lands.
al_power_FirstCut_desc: Sneak attacks on unaware enemies are always critical
al_power_FirstCut_details: Every hit on an enemy that hasn't noticed you is critical, melee or ranged, on top of the sneak attack bonus, and your critical damage bonuses apply to it.
al_power_ReadTheFight_desc: Hits on a staggered enemy count as sneak attacks
al_power_ReadTheFight_details: It works on enemies already aware of you: every hit while one staggers takes your weapon's full sneak attack bonus, on top of the usual extra damage to a staggered foe. Unlike a true sneak attack, it isn't limited to once per creature every five minutes.
al_power_VowKeeper_desc: +$1% damage and skill experience for each star you hold with an oath, up to six
al_power_VowKeeper_details: Every star you hold that carries an oath counts, on any god's map, up to six. The bonus raises all damage you deal to foes and all skill experience you earn.
al_power_OathEase_desc: Your oaths that weaken you by an amount are $1% lighter
al_power_OathEase_details: Every oath that weakens you by an amount, such as less damage dealt or more damage taken, is reduced by this share. Oaths that simply forbid something, such as bows or blocking, are untouched, and every oath star still counts for Keeper of Vows.
al_power_Grudge_desc: An enemy that hurts you takes $1% more from you for 20 seconds
al_power_Grudge_details: Any creature or player whose blow takes health from you is marked, and each new hurt restarts its 20 seconds. Blows you fully block or dodge don't count.
al_power_VowWitness_desc: Players and tames within 10 m gain half your Keeper of Vows bonus
al_power_VowWitness_details: The share follows your current Keeper of Vows bonus, so it lends nothing without it. Players gain it to damage and skill experience, tames to damage only; it doesn't apply to you, and only the strongest witness nearby counts.
al_power_OathRing_desc: You always have at least as many stacks of Fortification as stars you hold with an oath
al_power_OathRing_details: Up to five oath stars count. These stacks don't add to ones you earn other ways, the larger count applies, and like all Fortification they never take more than half off a hit.
al_power_HealingReceived_details: Every heal you receive counts: food regeneration, meads, heals from other players and from powers such as Mercy. It multiplies with faster health regeneration from other powers.
al_power_Sanctuary_desc: You and players within 8 m regenerate health $1% faster and take 25% less from burning and poison, and tames there heal over time
al_power_Sanctuary_details: The hall reaches 8 m around you and moves with you. Where several players' halls overlap, only the strongest speeds regeneration, and tames inside heal a tenth of that figure, as a share of their health, every second.
al_power_Mercy_desc: $1% of your hits heal the most hurt player or tame within 10 m, you included, for 30% of the damage
al_power_Mercy_details: Each weapon, arrow or spell hit you land rolls the chance; bursts from other powers don't. The heal goes to whoever has the lowest share of health, and nothing happens while everyone is unhurt.
al_power_SafeHaven_desc: Other players and tames within 6 m take $1% less damage
al_power_SafeHaven_details: Your own haven doesn't shield you, though another player's does. Tames are covered whoever they follow, and where havens overlap only the strongest counts.
al_power_Selfless_desc: Other players and tames within 8 m heal 1% of their health a second
al_power_Selfless_details: Heals each hurt player other than you, and every tame whoever it follows, once a second. It comes on top of Breiðablik's faster regeneration rather than replacing it.
al_power_AllThingsWept_desc: Another player or a tame within 15 m that drops below 20% health is healed to half; once every 3 minutes each
al_power_AllThingsWept_details: It watches other players and every tame, checking twice a second, but never you. A blow that kills outright isn't caught, and each one saved must wait 3 minutes before it can be saved again.
al_power_SailSpeed_details: Only the sail is boosted, at half or full sail; rowing is unchanged. It works on any ship, as long as you are the one at the helm.
al_power_SwimStamina_details: Covers the steady stamina drain of swimming, so you can cross wider water before you tire. It works in any sea, lake or river.
al_power_SwimSpeed_details: Raises your speed in the water whenever you swim. Swimming still drains stamina as usual unless you also have Sea-legs.
al_power_SteadyKeel_desc: Ships you steer take $1% less damage from waves, rocks and capsizing
al_power_SteadyKeel_details: Only damage without an attacker is reduced, so serpents, other creatures and players still hit the ship in full. It protects any ship while you are at its helm.
al_power_FairWind_desc: The wind always fills the sail of a ship you steer
al_power_FairWind_details: While you steer, your sail takes the wind as if it came from the best angle for whatever heading you choose. The wind's strength is unchanged, so a weak breeze still sails slowly, and other ships feel the true wind.
al_power_ShipCaller_desc: At the shore, the Call Ship key brings the last ship you steered to the water nearest you; once every 10 minutes
al_power_ShipCaller_details: The ship comes to the nearest water at least 1.5 m deep within 30 m of you, turned the way you face. Your last ship is remembered between sessions, and if no deep water is near, nothing happens and the wait isn't spent.
al_power_DaylightDamage_details: Direct sunlight means daytime with no rain, not under a roof and not inside a dungeon or cave. Every kind of damage you deal counts, from weapons, arrows and spells alike.
al_power_DaylightRegen_desc: +$1% health and stamina regeneration in direct sunlight
al_power_DaylightRegen_details: Direct sunlight means daytime with no rain, not under a roof and not inside a dungeon or cave. Eitr regeneration is not affected.
al_power_Torchbearer_desc: A held torch warms you like a fire, never burns out, and its fire is $1% stronger
al_power_Torchbearer_details: Hold a torch in either hand to rest by it and keep the cold off, just as at a campfire. The stronger fire counts on hits you land with the torch itself.
al_power_MistBurner_desc: The Mistlands mist clears $1 m around you
al_power_MistBurner_details: The clearing travels with you wherever you go in the Mistlands, like a Wisplight's, but only on your own screen; other players still see the mist around you.
al_power_Bifrost_desc: When rain stops near dawn or dusk, a rainbow raises the health and stamina regeneration of players within 30 m for 5 minutes
al_power_Bifrost_details: The rain has to end where you are, in the hours around dawn or dusk. The rainbow gives 20% faster health and 30% faster stamina regeneration, and anyone who comes within 30 m of you while it lasts shares the time left.
al_power_RadiantJudgment_desc: Once every 2 minutes, a secondary attack calls down light on every enemy within 20 m for $1% of your weapon's damage as spirit
al_power_RadiantJudgment_details: The light falls half a second after the swing begins, on every creature within 20 m of you that isn't a player or tame, bosses included. It uses the weapon's base damage, not your skill or bonuses, and the wait starts even if nothing is near.
al_power_HideYield_desc: $1% chance that a kill drops an extra hide, leather, scale or meat
al_power_HideYield_details: Rolled once for each kill you land. The extra is one more of a hide, pelt, leather, scale or meat that creature can drop, so creatures with none of these give nothing extra.
al_power_TrophyChance_desc: Trophies drop $1% more often, and a kill in one hit always drops one
al_power_TrophyChance_details: The bonus scales the trophy's own drop chance rather than adding to it. A kill in one hit only counts when no player struck the creature before the killing blow.
al_power_MeatFood_desc: Meat dishes give $1% more health and stamina
al_power_MeatFood_details: Counts cooked meat and dishes made with it, such as sausages, jerky, skewers, lox pie and serpent stew; fish dishes never count. The extra fades along with the food, and eitr is not raised.
al_power_CallOfTheHunt_desc: Wild creatures that come within 30 m of you gain a star, once each: more loot and experience, and a harder fight
al_power_CallOfTheHunt_details: Bosses are left alone, and a creature is only ever raised once, however often it comes near. It works on any wild creature that wanders close, whether or not you fight it.
al_power_TrophyLore_desc: +$1% damage to a creature whose trophy you carry
al_power_TrophyLore_details: One trophy of that creature anywhere in your bag is enough, bosses included. Creatures with no trophy of their own never give the bonus.
al_power_SpearDamage_details: Counts every spear hit, whether you thrust or throw, and multiplies with your other damage bonuses such as melee or ranged damage.
al_power_ThrowSpeed_details: Only thrown spears are affected. A faster spear flies flatter and farther, making distant targets easier to hit.
al_power_ReturningSpear_desc: A thrown spear comes back to your hand when it lands
al_power_ReturningSpear_details: Whether it strikes a creature or the ground, the spear goes straight back into your bag, and into your hand if you hold nothing else. With a full bag it drops as usual.
al_power_PinningThrow_desc: $1% chance that a thrown spear roots what it hits for 3 seconds
al_power_PinningThrow_details: Only a thrown spear's hit rolls the chance, bosses included. A rooted creature can't move but can still strike at anything within reach.
al_power_SpearPierce_desc: A thrown spear also strikes every enemy in a line 6 m behind what it hits
al_power_SpearPierce_details: The line is about 2 m wide and runs on in the spear's direction of flight. Each enemy in it takes the throw's damage before your bonuses, as pierce.
al_power_WinterSpear_desc: Where a thrown spear lands, ice bursts, hitting enemies within 4 m for $1% of the throw as frost
al_power_WinterSpear_details: The ice bursts wherever the spear strikes, ground included, and catches the creature it hit as well as any others close by.
al_power_CompanionDamage_desc: Tames following you deal $1% more damage
al_power_CompanionDamage_details: Counts for every tame set to follow you, including wolves and other creatures you summon. Tames told to stay behind get nothing.
al_power_CompanionGuard_desc: Tames following you take $1% less damage
al_power_CompanionGuard_details: Covers every tame set to follow you, including wolves and other creatures you summon. Tames told to stay behind are not protected.
al_power_PackTactics_desc: +$1% damage to an enemy next to one of your tames, and your tames go for what you hit
al_power_PackTactics_details: Your tame must be within 3 m of the enemy for the bonus. Anything you hit becomes the target of your following tames for 8 seconds, pulling them off whatever they were fighting.
al_power_LickWounds_desc: With no enemy near, tames following you heal $1% of their health a second
al_power_LickWounds_details: Checked each second: while no creature other than players and tames is within 10 m of you, every tame following you within 30 m heals.
al_power_EndlessPack_desc: A killing blow leaves a tame following you at 1 health and unharmed for 10 seconds, once a minute each; the wolves Wolf-Sister calls stay
al_power_EndlessPack_details: Only tames set to follow you are saved, called wolves and other summons included. Wolf-Sister's wolves still count toward the limit on called creatures, and leave once you have been over 100 m away for 10 seconds.
al_power_HallWard_desc: While you are near, buildings you made take $1% less damage and don't rot in the rain
al_power_HallWard_details: Damage of every kind is reduced, whatever deals it, but only on pieces you placed yourself. You don't need to stand beside them; being close enough for the area to be loaded is enough.
al_power_RaidDefender_desc: Inside a raid, whoever it came for, deal $1% more damage and take $1% less
al_power_RaidDefender_details: Counts whenever you stand inside an active raid's area, whichever player it came for. While the raid lasts, the bonus covers all damage you deal and take, not only fights with raiders.
al_power_MendWalls_desc: A kill mends the most damaged building of yours within 10 m, and repairing one repairs all of yours within 8 m
al_power_MendWalls_details: Any creature you kill counts, and the damaged piece is restored to full health. For the mass repair, the piece you aim at can be anyone's as long as you may build there, but only pieces you placed are mended along with it.
al_power_BarredHall_desc: Raiders going for a building within 30 m of you come for you instead, and you take 25% less from them
al_power_BarredHall_details: A raider turns only while it is going for a building, anyone's, and you are within 30 m of it. The damage cut covers every creature a raid brings, wherever you meet it.
al_power_BanTheKind_desc: Hang a creature's trophy on an item stand you built: that kind can't damage your buildings while you're near, and takes $1% more from you
al_power_BanTheKind_details: Only the latest trophy you hung on a stand of your own counts, and the kind stays banned even after you take the trophy down. Every creature that drops that trophy belongs to the kind, and you guard your buildings from anywhere close enough for the area to be loaded.
al_power_PolearmDamage_desc: Polearms deal $1% more damage and knock back further
al_power_PolearmDamage_details: Only atgeirs and other polearms count. Knockback rises by about five thirds of the damage bonus, so the shove grows faster than the damage, and both multiply with your other polearm bonuses.
al_power_PolearmStamina_details: Covers every polearm attack, the sweeping special attack included, and multiplies with other savings on attack stamina.
al_power_SetAgainstCharge_desc: Holding a polearm, the first enemy to close within 3 m is staggered; once every 10 seconds
al_power_SetAgainstCharge_details: Your polearm must be drawn, not on your back. Any untamed creature that steps from 3 m or more to inside 3 m is staggered, checked four times a second; one already close when the cooldown ends won't set it off.
al_power_SweepFortify_desc: Each enemy your polearm hits gives a stack of Fortification
al_power_SweepFortify_details: Every creature a polearm hit lands on is its own stack, so one wide sweep through a crowd can fill you quickly. Fortification holds up to 5 stacks and fades 10 seconds after the last one you gained.
al_power_WallOfSpears_desc: Polearm attacks reach 25% wider and deal $1% more
al_power_WallOfSpears_details: Both the reach and the arc of every polearm attack grow, so sweeps catch enemies further out and further to the sides. The extra damage multiplies with your other polearm damage bonuses.
al_power_HoldTheGate_desc: While you stand still, polearm hits knock enemies back twice as far and slow them by half for 3 seconds
al_power_HoldTheGate_details: You must be on the ground and not moving when the hit lands, and it works on every creature your polearm strikes. Each hit restarts the slow.
al_power_Refuse_desc: An enemy you hit deals $1% less damage to you for 5 seconds
al_power_Refuse_details: Any hit you land counts, melee, ranged or magic, and each new hit restarts the 5 seconds. The cut applies to every kind of damage that enemy deals you.
al_power_ArmourBreak_desc: Each blunt hit breaks an enemy's guard a little more, +$1% damage from you per break; the fifth staggers it and starts again
al_power_ArmourBreak_details: Only hits that carry blunt damage add a break, and the breaks fade 10 seconds after your last blunt hit. The bonus covers all your damage against that enemy, whatever weapon you switch to, and peaks at four breaks just before the fifth resets it.
al_power_Interrupt_desc: Hits on an enemy in the middle of an attack stagger it $1% more
al_power_Interrupt_details: Any of your hits counts, melee, ranged or magic, as long as the target is mid-attack when it lands. Only the stagger the hit builds goes up, not its damage.
al_power_Reflect_desc: $1% chance that half of what hurts you is sent back at the attacker
al_power_Reflect_details: Only hits that actually cost you health can set it off, measured after your armor, and the blow returns as untyped damage that no resistance reduces. It reaches the attacker wherever it stands, archers included.
al_power_Verdict_desc: Every fifth hit on the same enemy passes judgment: it takes $1% more from you for 10 seconds
al_power_Verdict_details: Your hits on each enemy are counted with any weapon and the count never runs out, so every fifth hit renews the judgment. While the mark lasts, all damage you deal that enemy is raised.
al_power_MeadDuration_details: Lengthens how long a mead's effect lasts, such as a resistance mead's. Meads whose timer is a cooldown, like healing meads, are left alone.
al_power_MeadStrength_details: Raises the health, stamina and eitr a mead restores, whether up front or over time. Its other effects, such as resistances, stay the same.
al_power_MeadCooldown_desc: Healing meads come off cooldown $1% sooner
al_power_MeadCooldown_details: It shortens the timer of any mead whose timer is a cooldown, such as healing meads. Meads whose timer is how long they work are not touched.
al_power_MeadSave_desc: $1% chance that a mead isn't used up
al_power_MeadSave_details: A mead here is anything you drink that gives an effect but no food. When it triggers, a fresh one goes straight back into your bag.
al_power_TwiceBrewed_desc: A fermenter you tap gives one more
al_power_TwiceBrewed_details: The extra mead appears at the tap once per batch, from any fermenter you are allowed to use, whoever filled it.
al_power_Elixir_desc: Each mead you drink gives $1% more damage for 10 seconds and clears one ailment
al_power_Elixir_details: The 10 seconds restart with each mead rather than stacking, and the bonus covers all your damage. The ailment removed is the first you have of burning, poison, frost, shock, spirit, wet, smoke and tar.
al_power_BondDamage_desc: +$1% damage while you have a bonded one
al_power_BondDamage_details: You need Bonded to gain a bonded one. The bonus covers all the damage you deal for as long as any player or tame is bonded to you.
al_power_BondRegen_desc: +$1% health regeneration while you have a bonded one
al_power_BondRegen_details: You need Bonded to gain a bonded one. It speeds your own health regeneration, not theirs, for as long as any player or tame is bonded to you.
al_power_Bonded_desc: The nearest player within 15 m, or else a tame, is your bonded one; you, and a bonded player, gain $1% stamina regeneration and speed
al_power_Bonded_details: The bond is picked again every second, and a player always wins over a tame; only tames that follow you count. A bonded player shares your boost while within 15 m, but a tame gains nothing from it.
al_power_SharedBurden_desc: $1% of the damage your bonded one takes is moved to you
al_power_SharedBurden_details: Works whether your bonded one is a player or a tame. The share arrives as untyped damage that your armor does not soften, so heavy armor won't make it lighter to carry.
al_power_SeidrLink_desc: $1% of healing past your full health flows to your bonded one
al_power_SeidrLink_details: Only healing that tops you up counts: the part that would spill past full flows on, but healing that reaches you while you are already full is lost. Your bonded one can be a player or a tame.
al_power_Inseparable_desc: Within 10 m of your bonded one, deal $1% more damage and take 10% less
al_power_Inseparable_details: You need Bonded to gain a bonded one, player or tame. Both the extra damage and the guard switch off the moment you are 10 m or more apart.
al_power_Longing_desc: When your bonded one or another player near you falls below 20% health or dies, deal $1% more damage and heal for some of it for 20 seconds
al_power_Longing_details: Any other player within 15 m counts, as does a bonded tame, each time they drop low or die. While it lasts, each hit heals you for a share of its damage one eighth the size of the damage bonus, and it can't start again until 30 seconds after it began.
al_power_TradePrice_desc: Traders sell to you $1% cheaper and pay $1% more
al_power_TradePrice_details: Discounted prices round down but never fall below 1 coin. When you sell, the trader pays the usual price and the extra coins are added to your bag straight after.
al_power_CoinFind_desc: Coins you find on the ground count $1% more
al_power_CoinFind_details: Only loose coins picked up from the ground count, and only the first time anyone picks them up, so coins a player dropped or coins taken from a chest gain nothing. Fractions round up by chance.
al_power_Gersemi_desc: $1% chance that a world chest you open for the first time holds an extra valuable
al_power_Gersemi_details: Only chests that came with the world and hold loot of their own count, never ones a player built, and each chest is tried once. The valuable is coins, amber, an amber pearl, a ruby or a silver necklace, coins being the most likely.
al_power_Hoard_desc: Coins weigh nothing, and every 200 you carry give +$1 armor, up to 10
al_power_Hoard_details: Only full steps of 200 coins count, so spending a coin that takes you below a step loses that armor at once. The armor adds to what your gear gives.
al_power_GoldHunger_desc: +$1% damage for every 100 coins you carry, up to 25%
al_power_GoldHunger_details: Only full steps of 100 coins in your own inventory count. The bonus covers all your damage and changes the moment you gain or spend coins.
al_power_RedGoldTears_desc: While you carry coins, $1% of the damage you take is paid with 5 coins a point instead
al_power_RedGoldTears_details: It acts on every hit that lands, after your armor, taking the coins straight from your bag. When your coins can't cover the whole share, they cover what they can and your health takes the rest.
al_power_PoisonOnHit_details: Added to every weapon, bow and spell hit you land, before your damage bonuses, so they raise it too. Like all poison it hurts over a few seconds, and poison-immune foes ignore it.
al_power_PoisonDamage_desc: The poison your hits carry is $1% stronger
al_power_PoisonDamage_details: Raises the poison your own hits carry, a weapon's poison and Bile's alike. Bleeding from Open Wound, Rotting Ground's pulses and poison bursts are not strengthened.
al_power_Contagion_desc: An enemy that dies poisoned spreads poison to enemies within 4 m for $1% of its health
al_power_Contagion_details: Poison from the killing blow itself counts, and a foe your poison finishes off after your hit is your kill too. A boss counts as at most 1000 health, and poison-immune foes ignore the spread.
al_power_GraspOfTheDead_desc: $1% chance that a hit roots the enemy; one that dies rooted bursts into poison
al_power_GraspOfTheDead_details: Every hit you land rolls for it, and the root holds an enemy in place for 3 seconds, bosses included. If it dies to you while rooted, burning or poison you started included, enemies within 4 m take poison worth 15% of its max health, a boss counting as at most 1000.
al_power_PoisonDrain_desc: Heal for $1% of the poison your hits deal
al_power_PoisonDrain_details: You heal at once when the hit lands, from all the poison it carries, bleeding included. It counts the poison before the target's resistances, so it heals you even against poison-immune foes.
al_power_RottingGround_desc: Enemies within 5 m of you take $1 poison a second and deal you 10% less damage
al_power_RottingGround_details: The poison pulses once a second on every enemy within reach, bosses included, and doesn't set off your on-hit powers. The 10% cut applies to any attacker standing within 5 m when its hit lands.
al_power_SummonDamage_details: Works on summons that follow you: a staff's, and those your powers call up, such as Náglfar's thralls, Fólkvangr's einherjar and Wolf-Sister's wolves. Ordinary tames don't count.
al_power_SummonDuration_details: Lengthens a staff's summons as you call them, and the creatures your powers call up for a while. Companions that stay for good are not affected.
al_power_AscendantThralls_desc: Your summons gain a star for every three kills, up to four stars
al_power_AscendantThralls_details: Counts the kills of any summon following you, a staff's or one your powers called. Each star makes it stronger, as stars do for any creature, and it keeps them until it leaves.
al_power_ThrallsBurden_desc: $1% of the damage you take passes to your nearest tame or summon within 10 m
al_power_ThrallsBurden_details: Only a tame or summon set to follow you can take it. The share is taken after your armor and other protections and dealt to the creature as plain damage, so it may fall in your place.
al_power_Legion_details: Raises how many a staff can keep up at once, and the limit of three that your powers' summons share, such as Náglfar's thralls, Fólkvangr's einherjar and Wolf-Sister's wolves.
al_power_SoulEater_desc: Every creature that falls within 15 m, whoever felled it, gives +$1% damage and heals you a little; up to 20 stacks, for 10 seconds
al_power_SoulEater_details: Any creature's body counts, tames and other players' kills included, but not players. Each one also heals 1% of your max health and renews every stack, so they all fade 10 seconds after the last.
al_power_NightDamage_desc: +$1% damage at night, in the Mistlands and underground
al_power_NightDamage_details: Night means the game's night hours, while the Mistlands and dungeons such as crypts and caves count at any hour. Applies to every weapon, bow and spell hit.
al_power_NightStealth_desc: You are $1% harder to notice at night, in the Mistlands and underground
al_power_NightStealth_details: Only matters while you sneak. The Mistlands and dungeons such as crypts and caves count at any hour, and the bonus stacks with your other stealth bonuses.
al_power_Dread_desc: $1% chance that a hit makes an enemy that isn't a boss flee for a moment
al_power_Dread_details: Every hit you land rolls for it. The fright lasts 3 seconds, in which the enemy breaks off and runs instead of attacking you, and only one enemy at a time can be sent running.
al_power_HelsGaze_desc: At night, enemies within 8 m deal you $1% less damage
