al_power_HelsGaze_details: Distance is measured as each hit arrives, so archers and casters further off hit you as usual. Only night counts, not the Mistlands or dungeons by day.
al_power_ChildOfNight_desc: At night, deal $1% more damage and move faster
al_power_ChildOfNight_details: Your speed rises by half as much as your damage. Only night counts, not the Mistlands or dungeons by day, and the damage covers every weapon, bow and spell hit.
al_power_Terror_desc: Each kill at night adds a stack for 10 seconds, up to 10: +$1% damage and some speed per stack, but more damage taken
al_power_Terror_details: Only your own kills at night add stacks, foes your burning or poison finishes included, but they keep working into the day until they run out. Each stack has its own 10 seconds; per stack your speed rises by a quarter of the damage bonus and your damage taken by half of it.
al_power_UnarmedDamage_details: Counts every hit that uses the Unarmed skill, so fist weapons such as claws and knucklechains count as well as bare hands. It also strengthens your Heel-stamp.
al_power_SnowStride_details: Only the drag of deep snow is eased. Frost, tar, webs and other slows are untouched, and so is your speed on open ground.
al_power_HeelStamp_desc: A landing from 4 m or higher that would hurt you stamps the ground, at most once every 5 seconds: enemies within 4 m are staggered, bosses excepted, and take blunt damage that grows with the fall. You take $1% less fall damage
al_power_HeelStamp_details: The stamp deals 10 blunt for each metre fallen, counting up to 20 m, raised by your unarmed bonus. Bosses take the damage without being staggered, and a landing already made harmless, by a glide, a feather cape or Sure-footed, doesn't stamp.
al_power_IronGloves_desc: Unarmed hits add $1% of your armor as blunt damage
al_power_IronGloves_details: Uses your full armor as it stands, star bonuses included, and the added blunt is raised by your damage bonuses like the rest of the blow. Fist weapons such as claws count as unarmed.
al_power_ShoeOfScraps_desc: Leather scraps weigh nothing, and every 10 you carry give +1% unarmed damage, up to $1%
al_power_ShoeOfScraps_details: Only leather scraps in your own inventory count, in whole tens. The bonus multiplies with your other unarmed bonuses, and fist weapons such as claws count as unarmed.
al_power_FootOnTheJaw_desc: An unarmed heavy attack (a secondary attack or the last blow of a combo) on a staggered enemy pins it for 3 seconds (1 for a boss), and a pinned enemy takes 25% more damage from everyone
al_power_FootOnTheJaw_details: The enemy must already be staggered when the blow lands. A pinned enemy can't move, the extra damage applies to every hit from anyone while the pin lasts, and fist weapons such as claws count as unarmed.
al_power_ColdEndurance_desc: Cold and Freezing slow your regeneration $1% less
al_power_ColdEndurance_details: Eases how much Cold and Freezing cut both your health and stamina regeneration, each time they come over you. It doesn't stop you getting cold.
al_power_SnowShed_desc: Snow doesn't pile up on buildings within $1 m of you, so it can't break them
al_power_SnowShed_details: Covers anyone's buildings, not just yours, and the shelter moves with you, so buildings beyond your reach gather snow as usual.
al_power_ThreeWinters_desc: Each minute you spend Cold or Freezing gives +$1% damage and 2% less damage taken, up to five times; warming at a fire clears them
al_power_ThreeWinters_details: Cold minutes add up across separate spells, and the stacks stay with you indoors or in warmer lands until you stand by a fire or die. Both the damage and the protection apply to every hit.
al_power_WinterBound_desc: In the Mountains, the Deep North and anywhere freezing: +$1% damage and stamina regeneration
al_power_WinterBound_details: Freezing weather counts wherever you are, but merely being Cold elsewhere doesn't. The damage covers every weapon, bow and spell hit.
al_power_Fimbulvetr_desc: A blizzard follows you: enemies within 8 m move 20% slower and hit 15% softer, and other players inside it can't freeze
al_power_Fimbulvetr_details: The chill is renewed every second and fades 2 seconds after an enemy leaves; bosses are chilled too. It doesn't stop you yourself from freezing.
al_power_GreatFoeDamage_desc: +$1% damage to great foes: bosses, and creatures with at least twice your max health
al_power_GreatFoeDamage_details: Max health is compared with your own as you strike, so it shifts with your food. Applies to every weapon, bow and spell hit.
al_power_Unbound_desc: Slows, roots, webs and tar on you wear off $1% sooner
al_power_Unbound_details: Covers frost, tar and any other timed effect that slows you, such as webs. Effects with no timer of their own aren't shortened.
al_power_LongFight_desc: Each hit on a great foe gives +1% damage against it, up to $1%, until 10 seconds pass without a hit
al_power_LongFight_details: A great foe is a boss or a creature with at least twice your max health. Each foe keeps its own count, so switching targets starts again, and only your weapon, bow and spell hits add to it.
al_power_WolfSworn_details: A great foe is a boss or a creature with at least twice your max health, measured as you strike. This bonus multiplies with Giant-feller rather than adding to it, and covers every weapon, bow and spell hit.
al_power_TearTheJaws_desc: A heavy melee attack (a secondary attack or the last blow of a combo) on a staggered great foe tears its jaws for $1% of its max health (less on a boss), once every 20 seconds for each foe
al_power_TearTheJaws_details: Only melee heavy attacks count, and the foe must already be staggered when the blow lands. The torn damage ignores armor and resistances and isn't raised by your bonuses; a boss takes 40% of it.
al_power_WrathDamage_desc: +$1% damage for 5 seconds after an enemy hurts you
al_power_WrathDamage_details: Only a hit that actually lowers your health counts, not one you fully block, and each new hurt restarts the 5 seconds. Applies to every weapon, bow and spell hit.
al_power_BloodDebt_desc: $1% of the damage enemies deal you is stored as debt, up to half your max health, and added to your next heavy melee attack (a secondary attack or the last blow of a combo); it fades after 10 seconds without a hurt
al_power_BloodDebt_details: Only damage that reaches your health counts. The debt goes into the first enemy struck by a melee heavy attack as plain damage that ignores armor and resistances, and your damage bonuses don't raise it.
al_power_DebtHeal_desc: Paying out your debt heals you for $1% of it
al_power_DebtHeal_details: The heal comes when the heavy attack lands and is worked out from the debt as stored, so the Avenger's doubling adds nothing to it.
al_power_KinVengeance_desc: When a player or tame within 20 m dies, the creature that struck the killing blow is marked for 60 seconds and takes $1% more damage from you
al_power_KinVengeance_details: Any player's or tame's death counts, summons included, but only a creature that struck the last blow can be marked. Deaths to poison, burning or falls mark no one, and each new death renews the mark.
al_power_Unatoned_desc: Blood-debt stores another $1% of the damage you take, and no longer fades
al_power_Unatoned_details: It only works alongside Blood-debt. The debt still can't pass half your max health, but it waits until a heavy attack pays it out or you die.
al_power_Avenger_desc: When your debt is full, your next heavy melee attack pays it twice over and strikes every enemy within 5 m for as much, staggering all but bosses
al_power_Avenger_details: Full means half your max health is stored. The struck enemy and those around it are staggered unless they are bosses, and the doubled debt is plain damage that ignores armor and resistances.
al_power_Patience_desc: Each second you go without attacking gives your next attack +2% damage, up to $1%
al_power_Patience_details: Every swing, shot or cast counts as attacking, even chopping or mining, and any hit you land also restarts the count. The bonus goes to every enemy struck by the attack's first blow, bosses included.
al_power_Stillness_desc: After 2 seconds standing still, you are $1% harder to notice while sneaking and regain stamina 25% faster
al_power_Stillness_details: You must stand on the ground without moving at all; a step, a jump or being knocked about restarts the 2 seconds. The stealth part only matters while you sneak.
al_power_OneWord_desc: An attack at full patience staggers $1% harder, and staggers any enemy that isn't a boss
al_power_OneWord_details: Full patience means The Silent God's bonus has reached its limit. Only the attack's first blow gets it, and every enemy that blow strikes is staggered unless it is a boss, though bosses still take the harder stagger.
al_power_SilenceVow_desc: Patience builds twice as fast and goes $1% higher
al_power_SilenceVow_details: Patience then builds 4% a second instead of 2%, toward the higher limit. It does nothing without The Silent God.
al_power_SingleBlow_desc: After 8 seconds without attacking, your next attack deals triple damage (double to a boss)
al_power_SingleBlow_details: The wait counts from your last swing, shot or cast, and any hit you land restarts it. The bonus multiplies with patience and goes to every enemy struck by the attack's first blow.
al_power_Relearn_desc: Skills below the best level you have reached train $1% faster
al_power_Relearn_details: Each skill's best level is remembered even before you take this star, so earlier losses to death or Ascension count too. The bonus stops once a skill is back to its old best.
al_power_LastStand_desc: Below 30% health you take $1% less damage
al_power_LastStand_details: Your health is checked as each hit arrives, and the cut is taken before armor, whatever the source of the hit.
al_power_KindDeath_details: Only the loss from dying is eased, not what Ascension takes. It also softens an oath that makes death cost more skill.
al_power_Outlast_desc: Below 30% health you regain $1% of your max health a second and move 15% faster
al_power_Outlast_details: The healing comes once a second, on top of your normal regeneration, and both it and the speed stop as soon as you climb back to 30%.
al_power_GoldenPieces_desc: Opening your grave gives back the food you had eaten when you died, and 10 minutes of +20% experience and stamina regeneration
al_power_GoldenPieces_details: You must hold the star when you die, and only the first time you open your own grave afterwards counts. Each food comes back with the time it had left, if you have a free slot and aren't already eating it.
al_power_CraftCostPenalty_desc: Crafting and upgrading cost $1% more of each material, always at least one more
al_power_CraftCostPenalty_details: Every material in a crafting or upgrading recipe is raised and rounded up, so even a single piece costs at least one more. Building pieces cost the same as ever.
al_power_ForeignGearPenalty_desc: Weapons and armor someone else made give $1% less
al_power_ForeignGearPenalty_details: A weapon deals less and a helmet, chest, legs or cape gives less armor unless you crafted or upgraded it yourself, so found and bought gear is cut too. Fists and shields are spared.
al_power_AlertedDamagePenalty_desc: Deal $1% less damage to enemies that are aware of you
al_power_AlertedDamagePenalty_details: Cuts every hit on a creature that has noticed you; only foes still unaware, the ones open to a sneak attack, are spared. Other players always count as aware.
al_power_NightDamageTaken_details: Every hit you take while it is night is stronger, whatever its source. Night follows the world's clock, so caves and dungeons count too.
al_power_NoBlock_details: The block button does nothing, so you cannot raise a shield or weapon to block or parry.
al_power_UnbannedDamagePenalty_desc: While a kind is banned, deal $1% less damage to every other kind
al_power_UnbannedDamagePenalty_details: Only bites while Ban the Kind is active and you have banned a kind by hanging its trophy on an item stand you built. Every other kind, and anything without a trophy, takes less from you.
al_power_DodgeStaminaPenalty_details: Every dodge roll costs more stamina, multiplied in with any dodge stamina savings you have.
al_power_AloneDamagePenalty_desc: Deal $1% less damage with no bonded one near
al_power_AloneDamagePenalty_details: Your bonded one is the nearest living player within 15 m, or else a tame following you within 15 m. Holding this oath forms a bond even without the Bonded star, so the cut only applies while no one is near.
al_power_LoseCoinsOnDeath_desc: Your coins are lost when you die, not left in your grave
al_power_LoseCoinsOnDeath_details: Every coin you carry is destroyed when you die, before your grave is made. Coins stored in chests are safe.
al_power_FoodValuePenalty_details: Cuts the health, stamina and eitr each food adds, for as long as it lasts. Your base health and stamina are untouched.
al_power_DayDamagePenalty_details: Cuts every hit you land on a creature whenever it is not night. Day follows the world's clock, so caves and dungeons count too.
al_power_ArmedDamagePenalty_desc: Deal $1% less damage with anything but your fists
al_power_ArmedDamagePenalty_details: Every hit that does not use the Unarmed skill deals less, weapons, bows, spells and tools alike. Fists, and claws that use the Unarmed skill, are spared.
al_power_WarmDamagePenalty_desc: Deal $1% less damage anywhere but the Mountains, the Deep North and freezing weather
al_power_WarmDamagePenalty_details: Your hits on creatures deal less unless you stand in the Mountains or the Deep North, or the weather around you is freezing. Freezing weather counts in any biome.
al_power_LesserFoeDamagePenalty_desc: Deal $1% less damage to anything that isn't a great foe
al_power_LesserFoeDamagePenalty_details: Great foes are bosses and creatures with at least twice your max health, so the line moves as your own health changes. Every other creature takes less from your hits.
al_power_ImpatiencePenalty_desc: An attack started within 2 seconds of your last attack or landed hit deals $1% less with its first blow
al_power_ImpatiencePenalty_details: Starting an attack less than 2 seconds after your last attack or landed hit weakens its first blow. Each swing of a combo is a new attack, so only a pause keeps full strength.
al_golden_pieces: The golden pieces lie in the grass
al_ship_resting: Your ship can't be called again for $1 min
al_ship_none: You haven't steered a ship yet
al_ascend_cost_ragnarok: Ragnarök comes $1 in-game days sooner, for everyone in this world.
al_ragnarok_nearer: $1 has Ascended. Ragnarök draws $2 days nearer.
al_setup_welcome_intro: The gods are watching. Each biome's deity has a star map: earn that deity's star points and spend them on linked stars for new powers, with oaths on the strongest. Once every boss has fallen, Ascend with a deity to start over in their name and open their final stars.
al_setup_welcome_setup: This short setup chooses how your world plays: how star points are earned, whether deity looks are shown, and what Ascension costs. Each page starts from the current settings, and nothing changes until you save.
al_setup_welcome_later: Open it again any time from the Mod Config button at the bottom right of the main menu, or of the pause menu while you host or are a server admin.
al_setup_welcome_server: On someone else's server, that server's settings are used, so you can close this.
al_setup_deeds_intro: Star points belong to one deity and are spent in that deity's star map. These deeds always earn them; turn off any you don't want.
al_setup_souls: Claiming a boss's Soul of Power
al_setup_souls_hint: For the boss's deity, once per boss per run.
al_setup_minibosses_hint: Brenna, Geirrhafa, Zil and Thungr, and the Fallen Valkyrie, once each per run.
al_setup_heralds_hint: Every kill, for the herald's deity, during Eternal Hall's Ragnarök cycle.
al_setup_heralds_hint_missing: Needs Eternal Hall's Ragnarök cycle, which is not installed.
al_setup_quests_hint: Slay the biome's boss for its deity, then wait for the next quest.
al_setup_luck_intro: The gods sometimes reward everyday deeds by chance. A kill or harvest counts for the deity of its biome, and a lucky craft goes to a random deity whose biome you have found.
al_setup_lucky_hint: Starred kills at or past your biome, crafting and harvesting.
al_setup_looks_intro: Stars and Ascension give each deity's looks: an aura, wings, footprints, a weapon glow and a kill effect. Players choose which to wear in the star map's Looks panel. They are only for show.
al_setup_looks_hint: Off, nobody shows any and the star map has no Looks button. Players keep the looks they have earned, so turning this back on brings them back.
al_setup_ascension_intro: Once every boss has fallen, a player can Ascend at a shrine: start over in a deity's name to open their final stars, gain their points and keep their looks for good. Choose what it costs.
al_setup_ascension_start: The player returns to the start
al_setup_ascension_keys_hint: These are the world's boss keys, so this resets boss progress for every player.
al_setup_ragnarok_hint: During Eternal Hall's Ragnarök cycle. If that would pass the end of the countdown, Ragnarök comes in half a day instead.
al_setup_ragnarok_hint_missing: Needs Eternal Hall's Ragnarök cycle, which is not installed, so this does nothing for now.
al_setup_discard: Unsaved changes. Press X again to discard them.
